newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Europe 1997 aluminium output, demand seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Europe 1997 aluminium output, demand seen higher.

text.p: Western world consumption of primary aluminium is expected to rise by 4.0 percent in 1997, with Europe fully recovering from a 1996 decrease, the European Aluminium Association said on Tuesday.
It added in a statement that western European primary aluminium production rose only 1.9 pct to 3.19 million tonnes in 1996 compared with 1995.
No forcast was immediately available for 1997.
The members of the European Aluminium Association are Austria, Belgium, Britain, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and Turkey.
